hivemq-extension.name: V2X Geohash Routing Extension
hivemq-extension.author: USDOT V2X Team
hivemq-extension.description: Routes J2735 BSM messages based on geohash. Intercepts BSM publishes to /v2x/1/ingress/bsm, extracts location, computes geohash and 3x3 neighbors, then re-publishes to /v2x/1/geo/{geohash}/bsm. Rewrites egress subscriptions (/v2x/1/egress/{messageType}/#) to geohash topics.
